ideas.description: Confound ablation of E126, which may also turn up a -2% time lever. Base: E116 code (82e6219). Precondition, free: log the source hash and a diff against 82e6219. Run the 28 and 32 px phases at bs 1536 instead of 1024, with two differences from E126: (1) the SGD groups (BN biases, whitening bias, head bias) keep their bs-1024 per-step values in those phases, with no kilostep rescale; (2) the final-EMA window and the lookahead stop are pinned to the tip's sample count (~8192 samples, i.e. the last ~5 steps at bs 1536, final EMA ~2 updates spaced to cover the same samples). LR warmup/decay, the floor-hold, the renorm cadence, the 85% freeze and Muon x1.25 at 32 px stay sample-indexed; Muon lr and momentum are unchanged. Reuse E126's warmed bs-1536 28/32 px graphs (every freeze x renorm variant) and verify no recompiles on a 2-trial TORCH_LOGS=recompiles dev run. Accuracy is decided untimed on seeds 3-102 in one fresh process against the pooled ~198-trajectory E116 baseline (SE ~0.032), with an E126 same-seed comparison. Add one scored run with per-trial logs.
ideas.expected: Time about -2.1% (~4.17 s, as E126). Under the update-count mechanism (H11.2) the loss is ≥0.12 pp, reproducing most of E126's -0.18; my central estimate is -0.08 to -0.15 pp. If the loss is ≤0.05 pp (population ≥0.7516, above the 0.7513 floor), E126's cost came from the SGD rescale or the EMA window. Bank it under H4.9 as a -2.1% lever at ~0.02 pp per 1%; I146 (bs 768 late) then loses its basis and should be dropped. If the loss is ≥0.12 pp, update count is confirmed, late batch size stays closed, and I146 becomes the live H11 test.

ideas.description: Weaker late augmentation. Base: E116 code. In the 28 and 32 px phases only, reduce the translate magnitude from 2 to 1 px. Keep the same reflect-pad fused GPU op with the pad width as a host-side per-phase constant, and keep the alternating flip. The 16/24 px phases, LS, the schedule, the freeze and the tail are unchanged. If the augment op is compiled, warm the pad-1 variant in build and check on a 2-trial dev run that nothing recompiles. Smoke-test one batch for range and shape. Accuracy is decided untimed on seeds 3-102 in one fresh process against the pooled E116 baseline. Add one scored run. Translate 0 is a follow-up only if translate 1 gains ≥+0.04 pp.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (±0.3%). Augmentation response is steep (translate 4: -0.56 pp, E131), and the run is under-trained at ~1 pp per 32 px epoch, so weaker late augmentation may help. My central estimate is -0.05 to +0.10 pp. A gain of ≥+0.08 pp (~2.5 SE) restores margin (population ~0.7529), which funds a ~1.5% 32 px trim at the 0.054 pp per 1% rate. Then queue translate 0 and a combined trim. A loss of ≥0.05 pp means translate 2 is at the optimum and augmentation strength closes in both directions.

ideas.description: Re-screen label smoothing at population level under Muon. Base: E116 code. Change only the label-smoothing constant from 0.3 to 0.2, a loss constant inside the compiled train graph. Re-warm the graphs in build if the constant is baked in, and verify no recompiles on a dev run. Nothing else changes. Accuracy is decided untimed on seeds 3-102 in one fresh process against the pooled E116 baseline. Add one scored run. E037 (LS 0.2, 3 seeds, SE ~0.2 pp) could not exclude ±0.3 pp; tuned Muon CIFAR recipes use LS ~0.09.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged. Central estimate -0.08 to +0.10 pp. A gain of ≥+0.08 pp gives zero-time margin worth ~1.5% of time through a 32 px trim, and LS 0.15 becomes the next arm. A result within ±0.05 pp closes LS at population level (E009/E037/E078 then all agree). A loss of ≥0.08 pp means the target-side regularization binds even more than under SGD.

ideas.description: The SGD multiplier on the BN biases was inherited from the SGD era and never re-tested under Muon. Base: E116 code. Change only the LR multiplier of the BN-bias SGD group from 64x to 32x, through its 0-d LR tensor or a host constant so nothing recompiles. The whitening-stem bias (E093 showed it is fragile), the head bias, the warmup and the Muon groups are unchanged. Accuracy is decided untimed on seeds 3-102 in one fresh process against the pooled E116 baseline. Add one scored run.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged. Under Muon the filters are renormed and orthogonally updated, so the 64x BN-bias LR may now add noise, since it was sized for SGD lr 9 dynamics. Central estimate -0.05 to +0.10 pp. A gain of ≥+0.08 pp is a margin source, with 16x as the next arm. A loss of ≥0.08 pp means the BN biases carry fast adaptation (consistent with E051's warmup sensitivity); then 96x is worth one arm. A result within ±0.05 pp closes the bias multiplier.

ideas.description: Structural early-stage redesign, profiled untimed before any accuracy run. Base: E116 code. Build three variants in a side script: (a) group 1's max-pool moved from after conv3 to after conv1, so the residual conv2/conv3 run at 15x15x128 instead of 31x31x128; (b) group-1 width 96 instead of 128, with group-2 conv1 input 96 and Muon stacks plus dirac init re-batched; (c) both. Compile and warm every (resolution, batch) x freeze x renorm x whiten-bias-grad shape. Measure ms/step and NVML energy over 20 steps per shape (16/24 px bs 1536, 28/32 px bs 1024, frozen 32 px variant), and project total time over the E116 schedule. Score at 100 seeds against the pooled E116 baseline only the variants projecting ≥8% saving, best projected first. Bar: loss ≤0.044 pp per 1% (fundable by 32 px re-spend). For the scored row, rerun E116 unchanged unless a variant qualifies.
ideas.expected: Projection: (a) saves ~10-14% (stem + group 1 hold ~31% of 32 px backward, E122, plus forward and BN/GELU bytes on the largest maps); (b) saves ~5-7%; (c) saves ~14-18%. Accuracy has a low-to-moderate prior. Early high-resolution capacity was fragile (E093, E032), but group-1 conv3 removal traded at only ~0.04 pp per 1% (E127). Central estimate for (a): -0.3 to -0.6 pp, i.e. 0.03-0.05 pp per 1%. A rate ≤0.044 pp per 1% would be the first lever to move the frontier (H14), funded by re-spending ~half the saving on 32 px for a net ~-4 to -6%. If no variant projects ≥8%, structural early-stage changes close with no accuracy run.

ideas.description: Clean 16 px trim that separates trim value from schedule-rescale artifacts. Base: E116 code. Drop only the first 0.5 epoch of the 16 px phase: start the sample-indexed schedule at 0.5 epoch in, so every later event keeps its absolute sample position (LR decay, floor-hold, renorm cadence, whitening-bias detach, 85% freeze, 24/28/32 px switches). The LR warmup is kept in steps from the new start. Total samples 6.75 epochs. All shapes are already warmed; verify no recompiles on a 2-trial dev run. Accuracy is decided untimed on seeds 3-102 in one fresh process against the pooled E116 baseline, same base, and compared with E132's rescaled trim on the same seeds. Add one scored run.
ideas.expected: Time about -3% (~4.13 s, as E132). Frontier prediction (H14): loss ≥0.12 pp (≥0.04 pp per 1%), similar to E132's -0.17. If the loss is ≤0.05 pp, E132's cost was a rescale artifact (warmup and decay compression), and the 16 px trim reopens as a ~0.015 pp per 1% lever that keeps the population ≥0.7513 and is bankable under H4.9. H8.3 would then be marked a confounded refutation.

drop.reason: Its own gate fails. I145 said to skip if 3/3/2 lost ≥0.45 pp, and E130 (3/3/2) lost 0.48 pp, so group-3 capacity is too valuable. E005 and the futurebiohackers sweep also favour 576. Prior for group-3 width 512 is too low to spend a run.

structured_output.summary:
The tip is E116 code: 4.26 s, population mean 0.7521. It sits on a roughly equalized-rate frontier (~0.05 pp per 1%), and only ~0.08 pp of margin remains above the 0.7513 policy floor. That makes zero-time accuracy the main exploit currency, alongside one possible confound-hidden time lever.

New ideas:
- **H11.2.2 (priority 4):** the E126 confound ablation. Late bs 1536 with the SGD groups not rescaled and the EMA window sample-matched. If the loss is ≤0.05 pp, this banks -2.1% directly; it also decides whether I146 is worth running.
- **H12.4.1 (priority 4):** translate 1 px in the late phases. The augmentation response is steep and the regime under-fits.
- **H15.1.1 (priority 3):** LS 0.2 re-screened at 100 seeds.
- **H15.2.1 (priority 3):** BN-bias SGD multiplier 32x. Never re-tested under Muon.
- **H14.2.1 (priority 3, explore):** an untimed profile of structural changes to the 31x31 stage: the group-1 pool moved earlier and/or width 96. Accuracy is scored only if a variant projects ≥8% saving.
- **H14.1.1 (priority 2, explore):** a clean 16 px trim with absolute schedule positions kept, to tell real trim value apart from rescale artifacts.

Dropped I145: its own gate failed, since 3/3/2 lost 0.48 pp. Kept I144 (BN eval mode in the frozen window plus the H2.21.3 measurement) and I146 (late bs 768, best run after H11.2.2). I140 is still running. The queue now holds 8 queued ideas.
